AaveV2InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V2 instance. Thin subclass of AaveV3InstancesMeta (same DataProvider ABI; pool resolved via getLendingPool()). The active instance set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the instance ProtocolDataProvider). positionId derived on-chain = the instance LendingPool; name = LendingPoolAddressesProvider.getMarketId(). Supersedes the per-instance AaveV2_* adapters, disabled below.

AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. The active instance set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the instance ProtocolDataProvider). Supersedes the per-instance AaveV3_* adapters, disabled below. positionId derived on-chain = the instance Pool; name = PoolAddressesProvider.getMarketId().

MorphoVault_kpkEURC_V1.$comment: kpk EURC vault (MetaMorpho ERC4626). Superseded by MorphoVaultsMeta (ADR 0010); vault still queried via metaInstances.

MorphoVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Morpho ERC4626 vault. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator and is applied via setMetaInstances in 06_Configure (from `metaInstances` below). This SUPERSEDES the per-vault MorphoVault_* adapters, which are disabled below — the NAV calculator now learns the Morpho-vault universe from this list.

ERC4626Wrap_sGHO.$comment: Aave sGHO savings vault (ERC-4626). sGHO.asset() returns GHO; convertToAssets unwraps shares to GHO-equivalent. Held by the Alpha funds. At fork block 25230126, redeem() returned exactly convertToAssets() (no exit fee/cooldown), so convertToAssets does not over-report. Share price is >= 1 GHO (yield vault), not a 1:1 share/asset peg.

ERC4626Wrap_waEthLidoGHO.$comment: Aave V3 Lido instance stata-token wrap of aEthLidoGHO. waEthLidoGHO.asset() returns GHO; convertToAssets unwraps shares to GHO-equivalent. ACCOUNT_11 holds ~$233 of this token. Production adapter not deployed yet — integration test deploys it ephemerally from this config block. Run script/deploy/04_DeployBalanceAdapters.s.sol post-PR-merge to deploy and write the address back into `deployed`.

MorphoMarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Morpho Blue market. The active marketId set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstancesRaw below). Supersedes the per-market MorphoMarket_* adapters, which are disabled below.

GearboxMarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Gearbox V3 ERC4626 farming pool. Emits one Supply leg per market (convertToAssets(balanceOf)) in the pool's underlying. The active market set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the market/pool address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = market address; name = market name(). Supersedes the per-market GearboxMarket_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V3 pool's wallet-held (unstaked) AMM liquidity only. The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the pool/BPT address). Gauge-staked LP + rewards are the separate BalancerV3GaugesMeta adapter. positionId derived on-chain = the pool address; name = BPT token name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV3GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V3 gauge's staked LP + BAL/extra rewards. The active gauge set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the gauge address). Wallet-held (unstaked) LP is the separate BalancerV3PoolsMeta adapter. positionId derived on-chain = the gauge address; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V2 pool's wallet-held BPT, decomposed pro-rata into the underlying tokens (composable-stable BPT-in-pool token excluded; supply via getActualSupply() when present else totalSupply()). The instance coordinate is the raw 32-byte poolId (metaInstancesRaw below), NOT an address — the BPT address is derived on-chain as address(uint160(uint256(poolId) >> 96)). positionId derived on-chain = the BPT address; name = the BPT name(). Gauge-staked BPT is the separate BalancerV2GaugesMeta adapter. Disabled: no fund holds Balancer V2 positions today — the example instance is B-80BAL-20WETH, enable + add poolIds via setMetaInstancesRaw when a position is opened.

BalancerV2GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V2 gauge's staked BPT (decomposed pro-rata like BalancerV2PoolsMeta) + claimable BAL and extra reward tokens. The instance coordinate is the gauge address (metaInstances below); the BPT is read on-chain via gauge.lp_token() and its poolId via getPoolId(). positionId derived on-chain = the gauge address; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Wallet-held (unstaked) BPT is the separate BalancerV2PoolsMeta adapter. Disabled: no fund holds Balancer V2 gauge positions today — the example instance is the B-stETH-STABLE gauge, enable + add gauges via setMetaInstances when a position is opened.

AuraRewardsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aura pool. Instance coordinate = AURA_REWARDS (BaseRewardPool4626) address, resolved via rewarder.pid() → Booster.poolInfo(pid).lptoken. AURA token auto-detected from Booster.minter(). Supersedes per-instance Aura_* adapters, disabled below.

CurvePoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving wallet-held LP for every configured Curve pool. Instance coordinate = pool address. Supersedes wallet-LP reporting in per-instance Curve_* adapters, disabled below.

CurveGaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving gauge-staked LP + CRV + extra rewards for every configured Curve gauge. Instance coordinate = gauge address. Supersedes staked-LP + reward reporting in per-instance Curve_* adapters, disabled below.

ConvexRewardsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Convex pool. Instance coordinate = rewarder (BaseRewardPool) address. LP token resolved on-chain via rewarder.pid() → Booster.poolInfo(pid).lptoken. Emits Supplied legs (staked LP decomposed into Curve pool tokens) + Earned legs (CRV exact, CVX via cliff schedule, extra rewards). Supersedes per-instance Convex_* adapters, disabled below.

FluidFTokensMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Fluid fToken (ERC4626 lending vault). One Supply leg per fToken (convertToAssets(balanceOf)) in its underlying. The active fToken set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is an fToken address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = fToken address; name = fToken symbol(). Supersedes the per-fToken Fluid_fToken_* adapters, disabled below.

FluidVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Fluid T1 vault. Emits a Collateral leg (supply) and a Borrow leg (debt) per vault, aggregated over the account's NFT positions. The VaultResolver is the chain-level constant pinned in the constructor; the active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is a T1 vault address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = collSym/debtSym. Supersedes the per-vault Fluid_Vault_* adapters, disabled below. T1 vaults only.

CompoundV3CometsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Compound V3 (Comet) market. Emits base Supply/Borrow + per-collateral Collateral + COMP Rewards legs per comet. CometRewards + reward token (COMP) are chain-level constants pinned in the constructor; the active comet set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is a comet address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = comet address; name = comet name(). Supersedes the per-comet CompoundV3_* adapters, disabled below.

StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every StakeWise V3 vault. Emits a Staking leg (vault shares) and a Borrow leg (osToken debt) per vault, both denominated in the underlying staking asset. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below). underlyingToken is the chain-level constant (ETH sentinel on mainnet). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = vault name(). Supersedes the per-vault StakeWiseV3Vault_* adapters, disabled below.

UniswapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Uniswap V3 pool (Supply + Fees legs from the account's NFT positions). NonfungiblePositionManager pinned in the constructor; the active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pool address; name = sym0/sym1 feeTier. Supersedes the per-pool UniswapV3_* adapters, disabled below.

AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. Instance set on NAVCalculator via setMetaInstances (each entry = ProtocolDataProvider address). Supersedes per-instance AaveV3_* adapters, disabled below.

CompoundV3CometsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Compound V3 comet. Supersedes per-instance CompoundV3_* adapters, disabled below.

PancakeSwapV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every PancakeSwap V2 pair (one Supply leg per token). The active pair set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pair address; name = sym0/sym1 LP. Supersedes the per-pair PancakeSwapV2_* adapters. Disabled for the same reason as below: COW has no Chainlink feed on BSC, so the COW leg would be silently dropped. Enable once COW is priced.

PancakeSwapV2_ETH_COW.$comment: Cake-LP for Binance-Peg ETH (0x2170...) / CoW Protocol Token (0x5BfdAa...). Test holder 0x616dE58c011F8736fa20c7Ae5352F7f6FB9F0669 is the genesis LP. Disabled by default: COW has no Chainlink feed on BSC, so registering it would require a custom price feed first. Until that lands, NAVCalculator's per-asset registry filter would silently drop the COW leg of any PCS V2 ETH/COW LP and value the position only on its ETH side — i.e. understate it by ~half. Enable once COW is priced (or replace this entry with a different pair that has fully-priced tokens).
